title: Mir Mannu’s Victory and the Seizure of Lakhpat Rai

blocks.text: The battle narrative turns when cannon fire kills Kamar Din, yet Mir Mannu hid his father's death so the Mughal line would not break in panic. By keeping the loss secret and pressing the fight, he helps reverse the field at the very moment when collapse seemed possible.

The page then notes the Afghan setback and the recovery of Mughal authority, with Abdali forced back toward Kabul and away from Lahore. Victory in battle is immediately joined to a second reckoning in politics, because the man who survives the field now decides whom to punish at home.

That political reckoning falls on Lakhpat Rai. Mir Mannu seizes him, fines him, and hears Kaura Mal rehearse the crimes committed against the Sikhs, turning the page from warfare into an indictment of anti-Sikh brutality.
